title: Deser and Arnowitt graviton essay

tellings.quote: The pair wrote a paper about these theoretical gravitons in their 1954 winning essay for the Gravity Research Foundation.

plain: Two physicists, Stanley Deser and Richard Arnoux, wrote a paper about gravitons, the theoretical particles thought to carry gravity. Their paper won the 1954 essay prize of the Gravity Research Foundation, a group that rewarded essays on gravity. Michels tells this in an episode about antigravity, drawing on a piece called The G Engines Are Coming by a writer named Michael Gladish, as a sign that serious scientists were working on controlling gravity in the 1950s.
